_README: A versioned mini-corpus for the temporal-retrieval benchmark. Every version is seeded from an artifact ALREADY REGISTERED in this repository; nothing here was fetched for the benchmark, and nothing here is a legal claim made by the benchmark itself.
_PROVENANCE_WARNING: Every artifact behind these versions is an INDIA CODE RENDERING, not a signed e-Gazette PDF. scripts/verify_document.py reports NOT_PRESENT (no signature) for pas_rules_2014.pdf and INVALID (content appended after signing) for gsr642e_2020.pdf. India Code is an official government portal and a permitted source, so these are usable -- but no output of this benchmark may imply Gazette-verified provenance.
_SCORING_NOTE: Deterministic only. Numeric nuggets compare value+unit with tolerance; selection nuggets match a regex on the instrument or code name. There is no LLM judge anywhere in this harness, deliberately: an LLM judge would inherit the very recency bias the benchmark exists to measure.

instruments._CONTROL: NEGATIVE CONTROL, and not the kind the brief expected. Rule 12(1) has been stable at thirty days since 2014, so a naive current-corpus lookup gets it right for every date -- which is exactly why a benchmark made only of moved thresholds would flatter date-conditioning. But this repo will not SERVE it, because nobody has attested the artifact. The correct answer is therefore REFUSE, and both conditions are scored against that.
